findings.text: _ids_vacuum_field restates the b0-size rule that nova/imas/getslice.py::vacuum_field (line 11) owns in this same change: its tail re-expresses the owner's body instead of calling it, so after a commit whose subject is one owner for the vacuum-field read the rule still has two statements.

the wall's dd_version argument has no passing guard: the only test that reaches the wall build is tests/test_equilibrium_reader_cocos.py:211, marked xfail(strict=True) for a different failure, so dropping dd_version here again would leave every test green and the fix unprotected.

the fragment says every arm above was re-run at the head as finally committed, but the only head arm for tests/test_shape_inverse.py (logs/shape_inverse-two-arms-1294540.log, job 1294540, 2026-10-23T19:45Z) predates 3b28b8b64, 505298bfd, 2319a6e58, bef45f5a6 and fa01f7936; no later commit touches a module that test imports, so the result probably still holds, but the sentence records a measurement that was not made, and the base arm inside that same log is EXIT=4 with no tests run.

the gate table quotes 94.72 s for test_database and 7.30 s for test_pointconstraint (line 88), but the final-head logs the manifest names as the gate arm read 86.25 s and 5.01 s, so the record's headline metrics do not reconcile with the logs a promotion receipt would open.

int(self.homogeneous_time) is a real store fix the reader needs, but the brief admits scenario.py for a sign site only and this is a serialisation change, so the node widened the condition it was given rather than stopping to ask; the evidence fragment discloses it in the same terms.
the dispatch's required artifacts key (paths plus headline metrics) is absent; artifacts_note stands in its place, so the manifest field a reader or gate would look for has nothing to read.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to move the xarray equilibrium reader and GetSlice onto translate_equilibrium and carry the one dependent internal sign site; nova/imas/equilibrium.py:504-626 declares convention_fields, builds each slice's signal map from that slice's own observables and converts every convention field, :973/:977 invoke the refusal and then the build, and nova/equilibrium/inverse.py:252 drops the compensating negation with its reason in the docstring.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at manifest.md; status complete, sixteen commits listed, eleven final gate logs and three negative controls named, baseline_suite and after_suite are single-line JSON at be0ec1321 and fa01f7936, and the tests line is the literal command that ran, but the required artifacts key is absent and artifacts_note stands in its place.
item_verdicts.write_paths: every one of the ten paths in the diff is inside the manifest's declared write paths; nova/imas/scenario.py:89 is on that list, but the brief admits scenario.py for a sign site only and this change is a serialisation fix, which the evidence fragment discloses.

justifications.durability: tests/test_equilibrium_reader_cocos.py:122 fails if GetSlice.translated stops converting, tests/test_pointconstraint.py:50 fails if inverse.py:252 restores its negation, and tests/test_database.py:182 and :215 fail on either side of the cache check, but nova/imas/equilibrium.py:995 and nova/imas/scenario.py:89 have no test that reddens if they are reverted.
justifications.evidence: the ten named gate files have both arms recorded and green in logs/final-*.log, the new signed and refusal checks record 6 passed and 1 xfailed, and three negative controls redden their own assertion, but the evidence fragment's quoted durations disagree with those logs and its claim that every arm was re-run at the final head is false for test_shape_inverse.
justifications.fit: nova/imas/equilibrium.py:504-579 follows the surrounding class-attribute and method idiom and introduces no forbidden name, though check_convention at :554 repeats the eight-line translate_equilibrium construction of build_convention at :598, and the private import of _observed at nova/imas/plasma_source.py:10 reaches across a module boundary the owner does not export.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/imas/equilibrium.py:579-626 converts every field of convention_fields per slice through translate_equilibrium and records the cocos attribute, EquilibriumData.load at :932-960 refuses a cached dataset under another convention, and inverse.py:252 carries the sign once, so the goal is met on the build, the read and the load path.
justifications.reuse: plasma_source's private _translated and _vacuum_field are deleted in favour of nova/imas/getslice.py:50 and :11 and both callers now read the owner, but nova/imas/equilibrium.py:568 still re-implements the b0-by-index rule that getslice.py::vacuum_field owns without calling or extending it, which the dimension's rule scores at most 5.
justifications.scope_discipline: all ten diff paths are inside the declared write paths, but nova/imas/scenario.py:89 is a serialisation fix in a file the brief admits only for a sign site, and nova/imas/equilibrium.py:995 corrects the machine read's DD major, which the goal does not imply.
